sources.observed_relation: ## Goal Recover Canonical's developmental language/curriculum lineage and generalize it into a **cognitive-theater curriculum** that must be traversed before deeper semantic VM consumption. This is not a translation benchmark and not a claim that cultures have fixed cognitive essences. The developmental question is: ```text can one learner reconstruct and inhabit the same consequential relation through substantially different representational theaters without confusing any one surface for the relation itself? ``` ## Canonical donor lineage Recover and improve rather than rewrite from zero: - `provenance/historical-runtime/R194/source/venus_seed_v0/curriculum.py` - `ENGLISH_FOUNDATIONS` - `RELATIONAL_ENGLISH` - WITHHOLD / source / evidence / correction distinctions; - `provenance/historical-runtime/R194/source/venus_seed_v0/curriculum_r133_runtime.py` - L1 English; - L2 relational/discourse language; - L3 mathematics and logic; - held-out curriculum generation; - `provenance/historical-runtime/R194/source/venus_seed_v0/organism_language.py` - persistent learner-owned language state; - no project semantic dictionary in the learner-side surface mechanism; - EDU13/14 - self-curriculum
